Existing src/workflow.rb immediately copies stored text with "@records[id] = text.dup.freeze"; deferring that copy until consumption would allow caller mutation to change accepted text. Retire consumed pending state before invoking callback-capable work so nested flushing cannot duplicate it and nested edits can establish another burst.
